ranked.headline: Models couple spatial position and regulatory state in single-cell transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell profiles are now analyzed with models that explicitly encode cell position, chromatin state, and gene programs.

ranked.headline: Learned representations of single-cell and spatial data under incomplete measurements
ranked.summary: Recent work extends prototype, disentanglement and generative models to imputation and integration of incomplete single-cell and spatial measurements.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and new callers refine human variant detection across technologies
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and callers show that sequencing technology, coverage, tumour-only context and population background shape variant calls.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and metrics probe what biological language and generative models encode
ranked.summary: Genomic and protein models are being tested beyond accuracy, with new benchmarks and metrics for sequence understanding and structure generation.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware statistical methods for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics inference
ranked.summary: New inference frameworks model zero inflation, longitudinal participant structure, and spatial dependence in single-cell data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents constrained by explicit biological evidence across single-cell and drug tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple DE genes, provenance graphs, and tool orchestration with LLM agents, alongside benchmarks that test where such systems succeed.

ranked.headline: Genomic ML models generalise poorly across unseen cohorts and regulatory sequence logic
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark genomic AI on held-out cohorts and sequences, testing whether predictive gains survive distribution shift and whether models learn…

ranked.headline: Software infrastructure making genomic analyses portable, reproducible and inspectable
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend reproducibility to environment resolution and to browser-side or serverless execution of analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Synaptic, delay and modulatory parameters shape oscillatory regimes in neural networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published E-I study map how coupling and modulation parameters shape rhythmic states across network scales.

ranked.headline: LLM-assisted workflows automate model calibration in systems biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLM agents and calibration frameworks to multi-step model construction, with no experimental validation reported in the summaries.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose failure modes in sequencing data QC, assembly and quantification tools
ranked.summary: Recent evaluations test processing tools directly, identifying artificial count generation and hidden pipeline performance gaps in sequencing workflows.

ranked.headline: Reference-free scoring and efficient computation for protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Adaptive caching and graph-spectral metrics now make ensemble and predicted-structure analysis faster and reference-free.

ranked.headline: Probing whether DNA language models capture genomic structure, geometry, and uncertainty
ranked.summary: Tokenization choices and chromatin-aware evaluation are now being tested directly on DNA and biological foundation models.

ranked.headline: Read-level and amplicon-based tools advance microbial and ancient DNA genomics
ranked.summary: New tools move microbial genomics from assembled genomes toward direct analysis of raw reads, amplicons, and ancient DNA metagenomes.

ranked.headline: Graph attention and transformers model drug, protein and glycan interactions
ranked.summary: Sequence-only and structure-aware graph models are extending molecular interaction prediction to affinity, adverse reactions and protein function.

ranked.headline: 3D-structure-aware models predict protein interactions and protease specificity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply 3D geometric graph and transformer models to interaction, cleavage, and binding-affinity prediction.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts drug toxicity, KRAS resistance, and enzyme function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test ML predictors on kinome profiles, MD-derived features, and reduced sequence and expression features.

ranked.headline: Computational tools unify splicing, repeat, epitranscriptome and vesicle data for reuse
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications package outputs from established resources into unified, queryable formats suited to downstream reanalysis.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion of pathology images and omics for outcome and lesion prediction
ranked.summary: Strong discrimination in multimodal survival models does not guarantee calibrated risk, prompting evaluation beyond C-index.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for simulating, compressing, and predicting protein dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work reports infrastructure for MD setup, trajectory storage, and flexibility prediction from coordinates alone, reducing computational cost.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and transformer generators are being grounded in MD and QM data
ranked.summary: Generative models are now trained on MD and QM data to capture temporal and conformational structure beyond static geometries.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes trace gene duplication and lineage-specific innovation across taxa
ranked.summary: Whole-genome comparisons now span diatoms, cnidarians, Asgard archaea and prokaryotes, pairing new assemblies with synteny and phylogeny tools.

ranked.headline: Long-read and germline-locus tools refine immunoglobulin and TCR sequence annotation
ranked.summary: Long-read and germline-annotation pipelines are tightening sequence-level accuracy for immunoglobulin and TCR repertoire analysis.

ranked.headline: Spatial and temporal network structure governs ecological and transmission dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show movement direction, seasonal turnover and interaction timescale alter predicted outcomes.

ranked.headline: Models probe folding pathways, complex assembly and latent protein thermodynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether residue-network, AlphaFold, and ESM-2 models capture folding rates, complex accuracy, and phase distinctions.

ranked.headline: Literature-mined knowledge graphs organize evidence for candidate prioritization
ranked.summary: Literature-derived evidence is being converted into queryable graphs, with IEKB and TCMCard adding explainability and evidence-quality features.

ranked.headline: NAD-capped RNA mapping and unmapped reads reveal hidden genomic and transcript features
ranked.summary: Methods that resolve RNA 5' ends and assemble unmapped reads expose sequence and transcript features that reference-anchored approaches leave unresolved.

ranked.headline: Genomic position and 3D contacts shape regulatory element activity and expression
ranked.summary: Position-dependent expression and regulatory networks linking elements, 3D genome contacts and variation are now being quantified and modeled predictively.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and pipeline tools segment histology and spatial transcriptomic images
ranked.summary: Segmentation and profiling tools for histology and spatial transcriptomics now ship as pretrained, open, and cross-organ resources.

ranked.headline: Computation guides receptor and kinase conformational states and cryo-EM constructs
ranked.summary: Simulation and fragment mapping now interpret GPCR and kinase states, and in silico design now sets a GPCR cryo-EM construct.

ranked.headline: Transferring biomolecular models to new chemistries, chain lengths and timescales
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether coarse-grained and generative models transfer beyond their training chemistries and timescales.

ranked.headline: Representation and integration methods link brain transcriptomes to disease biology
ranked.summary: Multi-omics integration of up to 1,358 aged brain samples and single-cell foundation models now offer routes from variants to cell-type function.

ranked.headline: Outer Membrane Lipid Organization Shapes Antimicrobial Peptide and Polymer Binding
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained simulations now resolve how LPS-phospholipid separation and polymer crossing shape outer membrane binding and translocation.

ranked.headline: Residue-resolved models probe UBL dynamics, host-virus interface selection, salt bridges
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool apply residue distance and elastic-network descriptors to protein dynamics and host-virus interface evolution.

ranked.headline: Structure, k-mer and synteny methods infer archaeal fold, genetic code and CODH function
ranked.summary: Structure-based, k-mer and gene-order analyses now support functional and taxonomic claims without direct sequence homology.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide data resolve population structure, admixture and polygenic trait shifts
ranked.summary: Whole-genome sequencing of Egyptians and ancient Western Eurasian genomes now enables population-scale and time-resolved inference of diversity and admixture.

ranked.headline: Joint multiomic profiling links regulatory layers to gene expression within samples
ranked.summary: Methods now jointly resolve copy number, replication timing, chromatin accessibility and expression within the same sample or dataset.

ranked.headline: Attractor and feedback formalisms define disease states and cellular set points
ranked.summary: Explicit dynamical models now define disease states through attractors and order parameters, tested on transcriptomes and patient survival data.
